title: Pentagonal Base And Open Flared Cup Batting Tee
description: One newly authored whole fixed batting-tee-inspired decorative display. A broad thick pentagonal base supports a complete short rooted socket, two slender coaxial mast sections, a full transition collar and one open flared ball-rest cup with an actual finite inner wall and closed bottom. The cup is genuinely empty, not a black disc, and the entire long mast and ground base remain present. Six closed complete components, three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. New numeric geometry, no bat, ski shaft, flower vase, stand or other old mesh extracted or resized. One original model and zero scenes. Broad baseball-practice equipment appearance only, no ball or user. The fixed overlapping mast sections merely suggest an adjustable exterior; no telescoping motion, ball compatibility, swing path, training performance, strength, loading, tipping resistance, dimensions for manufacture, real equipment or safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
